description: This file defines the React component 'RemotionRoot' which sets up multiple compositions and previews for a video editing application using the Remotion library. It imports other components such as HelloWorld, Logo, and NotesApp, and arranges them within Remotion's Composition and Still components to control rendering presets.

methods.name: RemotionRoot
methods.description: React functional component that renders different compositions in the Remotion editor environment.
